Technical Manual

## What this page is for

Use this page to find a menu action, controller or system location. Follow the
workflow pages for the steps you need to perform.

## Main locations

| Location | What you use it for |
|---|---|
| `scripts/stata/config/` | Start from the path template when configuring a workstation. Keep the completed local configuration outside Git. |
| `scripts/stata/menu/bnr_menu.do` | Check the current **User > BNR** menu labels. |
| `scripts/stata/monthly/` | Find the six CVD event release controllers. |
| `scripts/stata/mortality/` | Find the six mortality release controllers and supporting code. |
| `scripts/stata/reporting/` | Find the rolling, annual and one-off report controllers. |
| `site/surveillance/` and `site/downloads/` | Find public pages and approved public-data copies. |
| `site/methods/`, `site/operations/`, `site/technical/` | Find the Public Methods, Operations and Technical manuals. |

Keep confidential data, staging packages, local configuration, credentials,
logs and review evidence in the configured private locations outside Git.

## Workflow controllers

### CVD event release

| Step | Controller |
|---:|---|
| 1 | `monthly/bnr_step1_cvd_redcap_extract.do` |
| 2 | `monthly/bnr_step2_cvd_confidential.do` |
| 3 | `monthly/bnr_step3_metric_inputs.do` |
| 4 | `monthly/bnr_step4_metrics.do` |
| 5 | `monthly/bnr_step5_review.do` |
| 6 | `monthly/bnr_step6_publish.do` |

Step 5 has separate preparation and approval actions. Step 6 publishes the
approved files and checks the result.

### Mortality release

| Step | Controller |
|---:|---|
| 1 | `mortality/bnr_mort_s1_extract.do` |
| 2 | `mortality/bnr_mort_s2_classify.do` |
| 3 | `mortality/bnr_mort_s3_burden.do` |
| 4 | `mortality/bnr_mort_s4_review.do` |
| 5 | `mortality/bnr_mort_s5_approve.do` |
| 6 | `mortality/bnr_mort_s6_publish.do` |

The technical contract is
`scripts/stata/mortality/BNR_MORTALITY_WORKFLOW_CONTRACT.md`.

### Reports

| Route | Controller or controllers |
|---|---|
| Rolling update | `reporting/bnr_report_update_build.do` |
| Annual report | `reporting/bnr_report_annual_s1_build.do`, `reporting/bnr_report_annual_s2_approve.do`, `reporting/bnr_report_annual_s3_publish.do` |
| One-off report | `reporting/bnr_report_oneoff_s1_prepare.do`, `reporting/bnr_report_oneoff_s2_approve.do`, `reporting/bnr_report_oneoff_s3_publish.do` |
| Disclosure check | `reporting/bnr_report_disclosure_screen.do` |

The reporting contract is
`scripts/stata/reporting/BNR_REPORTING_WORKFLOW_CONTRACT.md`.

## Publication boundaries

- Stata creates and approves release-stamped event and mortality packages.
- Tables, dashboards and Downloads use the approved public files; they do not
  have separate analytical workflows.
- Standard reports reuse approved releases where their purpose allows.
- Quarto presents approved results. It must not recalculate or silently change them.
- Correct a release through the version or replacement controls in its workflow;
  do not edit generated files.

Positive counts from **1 to 5** are protected. Zero is not protected only because
it is zero. Product-specific code applies the full rules, and a person reviews
the complete proposed public package before approval.

## After a code change

Follow [Make a safe code change](../maintenance/safe-code-change.qmd). Check the
menu labels, run the relevant tests, check links, render the full site and make
sure Git does not contain private or unintended files.
